summary.content:
Today's selection covers 94 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 64 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: New AgingFly malware used in attacks on Ukraine govt, hospitals
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Exploited Vulnerability Exposes Nginx Servers to Hacking
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, The Verge, SecurityWeek, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 56 articles published in the last 24 hours
